target.title: fix(anthropic): add claude-fable-5 to CLI allowlist, aliases, labels, and context window
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

`claude-fable-5` — a production Anthropic model — was missing from the CLI provider path (`extensions/anthropic/cli-constants.ts` + `cli-catalog.ts` + `openclaw.plugin.json`), while the direct Anthropic provider path (`register.runtime.ts`) already has full support via `isAnthropicFable5Model()` / `resolveAnthropicFixedContextWindow()`.

Five metadata layers were missing, plus the `fable`/`fable-5` aliases weren't routed through the context/model-ref canonicalization paths:

| Layer | File | Consequence |
|-------|------|-------------|
| allowlist | `cli-constants.ts` | `openclaw configure` cannot select fable-5 |
| aliases | `cli-constants.ts` | `fable` / `fable-5` aliases unresolvable |
| static manifest | `openclaw.plugin.json` | `openclaw models list` hides fable-5 |
| label | `cli-catalog.ts` | Falls back to bare `${id} (Claude CLI)` |
| context window | `cli-catalog.ts` | Falls back to 200K instead of 1M |
| context/model-ref canonicalization | `claude-model-refs.ts`, `prepare.ts` | Bare `fable` alias uses 200K fallback instead of 1M |
| **fixed context window resolver** | `context-resolution.ts` | `claude-cli` excluded from Fable 5/Mythos 5 provider checks |

This is the same root cause as #100572: a new model was registered in the direct API path but the CLI path's independently-maintained constants were not updated.

## Why This Change Was Made

Add fable-5 entries to all CLI metadata layers **and** route the `fable` family alias through both canonicalization paths:

1. `cli-constants.ts`: add `claude-cli/claude-fable-5` to allowlist, add `fable`/`fable-5`/`claude-fable-5` aliases
2. `cli-catalog.ts`: add 1M context window, friendly label, and large-image tier for fable-5
3. `openclaw.plugin.json`: add `claude-fable-5` to the static `claude-cli` provider manifest so `openclaw models list --all` shows the model
4. `claude-model-refs.ts`: add `fable: "claude-fable-5"` to `DEFAULT_CLAUDE_MODEL_BY_FAMILY` so `resolveClaudeCliAnthropicModelRefs("claude-cli/fable")` returns the correct 1M reference
5. `prepare.ts`: add `fable`/`fable-5` aliases to `CLAUDE_CLI_CONTEXT_MODEL_ALIASES` so context budgeting doesn't fall to the 200K default
6. `context-resolution.ts`: add `claude-cli` to the Fable 5 and Mythos 5 fixed context window provider checks
7. `cli-migration.test.ts`: update 3 migration test expectations to include `sonnet-5`/`fable-5` entries produced by the updated allowlist

## User Impact

- `openclaw configure` can now select `claude-fable-5` for the Claude CLI provider
- `openclaw models list --all --provider claude-cli` now shows `claude-cli/claude-fable-5` with correct 1M context
- Aliases `fable` / `fable-5` / `claude-fable-5` resolve with correct 1M context window (was 200K)

## Evidence

### Tests

- `pnpm test src/agents/context.test.ts` — 67 passed (includes `claude-cli/claude-fable-5` and `claude-cli/claude-mythos-5` context-window test cases)
- `pnpm test extensions/anthropic/cli-migration.test.ts extensions/anthropic/index.test.ts` — 52 passed (8 test files total, 119 tests across 3 suites)
- oxlint — clean
- `pnpm format:check` — clean
- CI: all passing (Critical Quality, Security High, dependency-guard, Socket Security, CodeQL, QA Smoke)

### Real Behavior Proof

Built from head `1d26a88` on Node v24.13.1 (Linux x86_64) with `pnpm build`, then verified at both module boundary and CLI level:

#### 1. CLI Model Catalog (end-to-end)

`claude-cli/claude-fable-5` appears in the full CLI catalog with 1M context window and text+image input:

```
$ pnpm openclaw models list --all --provider claude-cli

Model                                      Input      Ctx         Local Auth  Tags
claude-cli/claude-fable-5                  text+image 1000k       no    no
claude-cli/claude-opus-4-6                 text+image 200k        no    no
claude-cli/claude-opus-4-7                 text+image 200k        no    no
claude-cli/claude-opus-4-8                 text+image 1049k       no    no
claude-cli/claude-sonnet-4-6               text+image 200k        no    no    configured,alias:sonnet
claude-cli/claude-sonnet-5                 text+image 1000k       no    no
```

#### 2. JSON Catalog Entry

`claude-cli/claude-fable-5` catalog entry confirms correct metadata:

```
Key:          claude-cli/claude-fable-5
Name:         Claude Fable 5 (Claude CLI)
Input:        text+image
Context:      1,000,000
```

#### 3. Module-level Verification

```
CLI Allowlist:         claude-cli/claude-fable-5 in CLAUDE_CLI_DEFAULT_ALLOWLIST_REFS → PASS
CLI Aliases:           fable→fable, fable-5→claude-fable-5, claude-fable-5→claude-fable-5 → PASS
Catalog Entry:         id="claude-fable-5", ctx=1000000, image=maxSidePx:2576 → PASS
Context Resolution:    claude-cli/claude-fable-5 → 1000000 (was undefined before fix) → PASS
                       claude-cli/claude-mythos-5 → 1000000 (was undefined before fix) → PASS
Model Ref Resolution:  fable → rewriteRef="anthropic/claude-fable-5" → PASS
                       fable-5 → rewriteRef="anthropic/claude-fable-5" → PASS
Negative cases:        openai/claude-fable-5 → undefined ✓, google/claude-fable-5 → undefined ✓
```

#### 4. Build Verification

`pnpm build` — all phases green. All 6 Claude CLI models enumerated in built dist catalog.

### Limitations

- **Not tested with a real Claude CLI subscription.** This system does not have an active Claude subscription, so the actual `claude auth login` flow and end-to-end CLI agent turn with `claude-cli/claude-fable-5` were not exercised. The fix is source-reproducible and module-level + CLI catalog contracts are verified. A maintainer with an active Claude subscription can verify the full `openclaw configure` → select `claude-cli` → choose `claude-fable-5` flow.
- The overlapping PR #101368 (narrower context-window-only fix) should be closed or retargeted if this broader PR lands.
